page_title: REI 0-1 STR | Reims v Strasbourg 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+8' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is shown a harsh red card by the referee as his tackle warranted no more than a yellow card!
90+7' Junya Ito (Reims) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+6' Junya Ito (Reims) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

90+5' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Djordje Petrovic pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+4' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Sergio Akieme (Reims) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Dilane Bakwa.
87' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
86' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
84' What was Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
83' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) trips an opposition player and Clement Turpin signals a foul.
82' Substitution. Hafiz Ibrahim makes his way off the pitch and Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) comes on as his replacement.
81' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
78' The linesman raises his flag. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is adjudged offside.
77' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
75' Buta (Reims) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call.
72' The linesman signals that Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
70' Substitution. Felix Lemarechal makes way for Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
70' Reims work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
69' That's the end of the game for Sekine Hiroki, who is replaced by Buta (Reims).
69' Samba Diawara decides to make a substitution. Amadou Kone will be replaced by John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims).
66' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
66' Strasbourg force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' The game is interrupted now, Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
59' What a chance that is! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
57' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute Joseph Okumu and he is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
57' A substitution has been made. Sebastian Nanasi is replaced by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg).
55' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
55' Chance! Keito Nakamura (Reims) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Djordje Petrovic is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
51' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Clement Turpin blows his whistle. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
49' Sergio Akieme (Reims) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
49' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.
46' Amadou Kone (Reims) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Djordje Petrovic.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Junya Ito (Reims) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Amadou Kone (Reims) for his blatant foul.
39' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
37' Junya Ito (Reims) jumps into a tackle and Clement Turpin signals a foul.
36' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
33' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
33' The resulting corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared.
30' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
29' Sergio Akieme (Reims) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
28' Keito Nakamura (Reims) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

25' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Yehvann Diouf pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
24' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
23' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
21' Celebrations are cut short for Reims as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
20' The Reims players joy may have been justified, because referee Clement Turpin is going use VAR to determine whether there was a handball.
20' The Junya Ito (Reims) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Clement Turpin rules it out for a handball.
19' Amadou Kone (Reims) picks up a rebound, makes a bit of ground then unleashes a shot from distance that dips at the last second and flies just over the bar.
15' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.

13' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Sergio Akieme (Reims) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off a brilliant save.
11' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
10' Valentin Barco sets up Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) with a lofted pass in the centre of the box, but his header flies just wide of the right post.
8' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is flagged for offside.
6' Cedric Kipre (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Clement Turpin saw the whole situation.
6' The referee blows his whistle after Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

4' 0 - 1 Sebastian Nanasi produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
4' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) will take a corner kick.
2' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) was too forceful with his tackle and Clement Turpin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Strasbourg will kick the game off.
Clement Turpin will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
